name: punk-cover
tagline_zh: 文章、小红书、公众号、X 帖，封面总丑？从朋克风格库一键生成封面和可复用提示词，连长文都能变图，平台比例自动适配。
tagline_en: Ugly covers for posts, notes, or tweets? Generate on-brand covers & reusable prompts from the Punk style library.
desc_en: Generate cover images and reusable image prompts from the shared Punk style library for articles, Xiaohongshu notes, WeChat public account posts, X posts, topic drafts, and requests for covers, social cover images, poster prompts, style-template-based image prompts, or image generation from long-form text. Use this skill to analyze source content, confirm platform/aspect ratio and visual style, sa
why_zh: 不止出图，更沉淀可复用提示词；风格库统一，长文直接转视觉，平台比例自动调。
why_en: It outputs reusable prompts, not just images—unified style library, long-text-to-visual, auto aspect ratios per platform.
